contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [?IMP]CONSTA[---]IVN ; R/ VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, possibly of Constantine II (317-340), Two Victories issue of 318-320, possibly Trier mint, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust helmeted and cuirassed left. Obverse inscription: [?IMP]CONSTA[---]IVN. Reverse description: Two Victories holding wreath inscribed VOT / PR over altar with motif of wreathed six pointed star. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP. In exergue: [PT]R. Diameter: 18.6mm, Weight: 2.70gms, die axis: 6
